```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)

weather <- read.csv("sarasota_hourly_weather.csv", skip = 3)
names(weather) <- c("time", "temperature_f", "relative_humidity_percent",
                    "precipitation_inches", "wind_speed_mph")
weather$time <- as.POSIXct(weather$time, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M",
                           tz = "America/New_York")
weather$rain <- weather$precipitation_inches > 0

temperature_high <- max(weather$temperature_f)
temperature_low <- min(weather$temperature_f)
rain_total <- sum(weather$precipitation_inches)
date_start <- format(min(weather$time), "%B %d")
date_end <- format(max(weather$time), "%B %d, %Y")
```

This report uses hourly observations for **Sarasota, Florida**, from **`r date_start` through `r date_end`**. Temperatures are shown in Fahrenheit, wind speed in miles per hour, and precipitation in inches.

```{r}
#| label: temperature-plot
#| fig-cap: "Hourly temperature trace across the week."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: 100%

ggplot(weather, aes(x = time, y = temperature_f)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#f6b26b", alpha = 0.28) +
  geom_line(color = "#c44e36", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(weather$temperature_f),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "#5f6b66", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = min(weather$time), y = mean(weather$temperature_f) + 0.7,
           label = paste0("7-day average: ", round(mean(weather$temperature_f), 1), " F"),
           hjust = 0, color = "#5f6b66", size = 3.5) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(75, 90, by = 5),
                     labels = \(x) paste0(x, " F")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(75, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "A warm week by the Gulf",
       subtitle = "Hourly temperature trace in Fahrenheit") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 19, color = "#243b3a"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#5f6b66", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#5f6b66"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fffaf4", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fffaf4", color = NA)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: rainfall-plot
#| fig-cap: "Hourly rainfall precipitation in inches."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| out-width: 100%

ggplot(weather, aes(x = time, y = precipitation_inches)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#277da1") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, " in")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Hourly Precipitation",
       subtitle = "Rainfall measured in inches") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "#243b3a"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#5f6b66", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#5f6b66"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fffaf4", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fffaf4", color = NA)
  )
```

The temperature ranged from **`r round(temperature_low, 1)` F** to **`r round(temperature_high, 1)` F**. Total recorded precipitation was **`r round(rain_total, 2)` inches**.
